analytical_interpretation.scope: Known-component relative analytical signal quantification, not independent absolute concentration or open-world structure elucidation.

tables.qualification: Measured NMR signal columns paired with independently computed trapezoidal component-window integrals. Targets are explicitly DERIVED analytical estimates from the same spectra, not independent concentration ground truth. Negative component integrals clipped only for derived area fractions; signed integrals preserved. NaNs are excluded within each integration window, never filled as measured zeros. Future-extracted component templates are forbidden inputs. SourcePMG284 contains999 native snapshots versus1000 nativeMnova rows, and noMnova labels are used. Three underlying measured trajectories; no random-snapshot independence claim. Numerical integration is the primary deterministic baseline; this task view is a reproducible analytical-processing contract, not evidence of a difficult concentration-estimation benchmark.
tables.reference_evidence: CC-BY4.0 Zenodo14814657 native cropped spectral matrices. Factual component/window calibration specifications are documented in official author config.json;5-second hydrosilylation sampling in src/utils.py and measured sucrose timestamps in the CC-BYtime-axis asset. Independently implemented numpy.trapezoid integration; no copied reference estimates or unpublished calibration.

tables.qualification: Derived simulation:12 seeded excitation episodes,50 transitions each,not600 experimental reactor runs. Native model usesA→B→C plus competing2A→D. Source equations, kinetics, heat-transfer constants, action bounds,0.005h sampling andC_b=0.6 objective retained. Integrator changed to deterministicSciPyDOP853; dynamic control evaluates a proposed policy with the explicit transition oracle. No claim of matching native robustMPC or proving plant safety.
